verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs show fast, feature-rich search tools (instant bulk search, AI-generated suggestions with alternate TLDs, IDN search) covering the 'instant availability + TLD suggestions' parts of the story well. However, there is no evidence addressing the 'no lookup-then-squat' honesty claim — nothing confirms or denies that Dynadot itself doesn't front-run or reserve searched names, so that key trust element is unevidenced. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of search speed, explicit anti-front-running policy or evidence Dynadot doesn't squat on searched domains, and any community testimony on search honesty.
